summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return for June 30, 2026, detailing a share repurchase on June 29, 2026, on the Nasdaq. The company bought back 996,882 ordinary shares at USD 1.9032 per share, representing 0.1068% of existing issued shares, which were held as treasury shares. The filing serves as a routine HKEX compliance disclosure for an equity issuer. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The repurchase is open-market and structural details are minimal. Watch for continued buyback activity and impact on liquidity.
